reasoning: The icon shows two vertical rounded bars, one solid and one outlined, which functions as UI chrome for a two-column layout toggle or a stylized media pause button. Because it is abstract interface chrome without a clear real-world object and is easily confused between a layout toggle, a pause symbol, or the number 10, it does not serve as a reliable glanceable task icon.
